Health Functional FoodManganese 1.5mgBiotin 150μgVitamin A 700μgVitamin B1 0.36mgVitamin B2 0.42mgVitamin B6 0.45mgVitamin C 100mgVitamin E 11mgSelenium 27.5μgZinc 4.25mgOnce a day

멀티비타민미네랄 구미Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc

Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주) · Once a day · 2 gummys

This product combines 1.5mg of Manganese, 150μg of Biotin, 700μg of Vitamin A, 0.36mg of Vitamin B1, 0.42mg of Vitamin B2, 0.45mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 11mg of Vitamin E, 27.5μg of Selenium, 4.25mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 gummys): 1.5mg Manganese, 150μg Biotin, 700μg Vitamin A, 0.36mg Vitamin B1, 0.42mg Vitamin B2, 0.45mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 11mg Vitamin E, 27.5μg Selenium, 4.25mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 gummys per servingChew to take

Biotin labelled (150μg / 6g), 80~180%

  • Those who want to take Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc together daily
